newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil looking for Bamerindus buyer - Malan.
newsitem.headline: Brazil looking for Bamerindus buyer - Malan.

text.p: The Brazilian government hopes to find a buyer for troubled bank Bamerindus before the PROER program for mergers and acquisitions in the banking sector expires on December 31, Finance Minister Pedro Malan said.

In an interview with newspaper Jornal do Brasil, Malan was asked whether a solution for Bamerindus would have to be reached before the end of the year. He replied: "I hope so, but we're still only in November."
The minister, keeping his answers short, confirmed the government was talking with potential buyers of Bamerindus.
